launcher.common_env:
# Copy to a lane-specific .env file. Do not store tokens here.
HF_HOME=/ai/cache/huggingface
UV_CACHE_DIR=/ai/cache/uv
TORCH_HOME=/ai/cache/torch
TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR=/ai/cache/torchinductor
TRITON_CACHE_DIR=/ai/cache/triton
PATH=/opt/rocm/bin:${PATH}
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rocm/lib${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}
MIOPEN_USER_DB_PATH=/ai/cache/miopen
COMFYUI_PATH=/ai/comfyui
H3_ENV=/ai/environments/comfyui-h3
H3_OUTPUT_DIR=/ai/artifacts/runs/minimax-h3
H3_BENCHMARK_DIR=/ai/benchmarks/minimax-h3

# Select the R9700 deliberately after rocminfo/PyTorch confirms device ordering.
# Do not uncomment based only on Vulkan numbering.
HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1

TORCH_ROCM_AOTRITON_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL=1
MIOPEN_FIND_MODE=FAST

# Promoted 2026-08-15 after h3-r9700-patch-20260814 campaign: autotuned
# flex_attention (Patch 2, upstream charlie12345/R9700AIProComfyUIPatch,
# fixed for AttentionTensorContainer compat -- see
# https://github.com/charlie12345/R9700AIProComfyUIPatch/pull/1) measured
# ~16% steady-state improvement on 864x480/124f/20-step H3 renders, no
# fallback, full model load throughout. Patch 1 (partial-rope) was
# rejected -- it was NOT applied to comfy/ldm/minimax/model.py -- it
# measured a small repeatable regression on this stack instead of the
# claimed speedup.
H3_FLEX_ATTENTION=auto
launcher.service_file:
[Unit]
Description=MiniMax H3 ComfyUI on Radeon AI PRO R9700
After=graphical-session.target ai.mount
RequiresMountsFor=/ai

[Service]
Environment=LTX_GEMMA_MIN_LENGTH=256
Type=simple
ExecStart=/ai/scripts/minimax-h3/h3.sh --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 8190 --disable-auto-launch
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
TimeoutStopSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
